title: Refund policy
text: Customers may request a refund within 30 days of a paid invoice. Only one full refund is allowed per invoice. Contact support with the invoice identifier.

title: Leave policy
text: Full-time staff receive 20 days of paid leave per year. Requests require manager approval at least five working days before the proposed start date.

title: Retention policy
text: Support transcripts are retained for 90 days after case closure and are then deleted. Legal holds suspend deletion until the legal team releases the hold.
